# Simple

> Simple is a demonstration business website layout built with Vue.js by Dawid Olko. It has one Polish page with services, industries, products, news and contact sections, split into components with separate data files.

## Pages

- [Home](https://simplelayout.dawidolko.pl/): the full layout with every section

## Author

- [Dawid Olko](https://dawidolko.pl): Fullstack / AI Developer, author of this project
